sn46.34:1.1: Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti || katame satta || || Satibojjhaṅgo bhikkhave anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anupakkileso bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati || la-pe || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anuppakileso bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati || || Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchiriyāya saṃvattantī ti || || Ayoniso
